brief.summary: Confident, easy denim dressing: high-waisted wide-leg or flared jeans with a shirt that has something to say — volume sleeves, smocked cuffs, a cropped stripe. Clear blues and crisp white against indigo or light-wash denim, finished with chunky white trainers.
signatures: shirt with volume sleeves and smocked cuffs
cropped striped shirt over a white tee
silhouettes: wide-leg and flared trousers, full length
